name: io.github.sgedda/mockifyer-mcp
title: Mockifyer
description: Query and edit Mockifyer mocks, scenarios, and traces via the dashboard API.

environmentVariables.name: MOCKIFYER_DASHBOARD_BASE
environmentVariables.description: URL mount prefix when the dashboard is under a path (e.g. /dashboard)

environmentVariables.name: MOCKIFYER_DASHBOARD_AUTH_USER
environmentVariables.description: HTTP Basic Auth username when enabled on the dashboard

environmentVariables.name: MOCKIFYER_DASHBOARD_AUTH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: HTTP Basic Auth password when enabled on the dashboard
